changeSet.author: navigator
changeSet.comment: v_lead_cdr_signals: per-lead metrics (30d) via n_call_log + n_call_log_lead; pickup_rate and inbound_ratio as percentages 0-100.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_lead_cdr_signals AS SELECT lk.lead_id,
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cl.status IN ('COMPLETED'))::decimal(10,4) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(*)::decimal, 0) AS pickup_rate,
AVG( CASE WHEN cl.status IN ('COMPLETED') AND cl.completion_details IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(cl.completion_details->'duration') IN ('number', 'string') THEN CASE jsonb_typeof(cl.completion_details->'duration') WHEN 'number' THEN (cl.completion_details->'duration')::text::double precision ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(cl.completion_details->>'duration'), '')::double precision END ELSE NULL END ) AS avg_duration_seconds,
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cl.direction = 'INBOUND')::decimal(10,4) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(*)::decimal, 0) AS inbound_ratio,
COUNT(*) AS total_calls,
MAX(cl.created_at) AS last_call_at
FROM n_call_log cl INNER JOIN n_call_log_lead lk ON lk.call_log_id = cl.id WHERE cl.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY lk.lead_id;
COMMENT ON VIEW v_lead_cdr_signals IS 'Per-lead behavioral metrics from n_call_log + n_call_log_lead over last 30 days; pickup_rate and inbound_ratio are percentages (0-100).';
